name: Shroud Abjurer
description: An exiled ward keeper who treats every delver as a contaminant. Her stitched veil hides her face while a forked staff grounds old curses.

abilities.description: Clears existing conditions and elemental traces at the start of every 3th round, before fresh applications.
Reduces incoming magical damage by 15 percent using the shared resistance rules.
